#恶性细胞预测
```{r}
ALL <- NormalizeData(ALL) %>% FindVariableFeatures(nfeatures = 2000) %>% ScaleData()
ALL <- RunPCA(ALL, verbose = F)
#去批次
ALL <- RunHarmony(ALL,group.by.vars = "orig.ident")
ALL <- ALL %>% RunUMAP(dims=1:20,reduction = "harmony")
ALL <- FindNeighbors(ALL, dims=1:20,reduction = "harmony")

#转换为scanpy对象
library(Seurat)
dyn.load('/usr/local/hdf5/lib/libhdf5_hl.so.100')
library(SeuratData)
library(SeuratDisk)
SaveH5Seurat(ALL, filename = "ALL.h5Seurat")
Convert("ALL.h5Seurat", dest = "h5ad")
```

#整理数据
```{r}
HSCT <- scRNA12[,scRNA12@meta.data$orig.ident %in% c('AML1007.1',"AML1007.5", "AML1010.1", "AML1010.5", "AML1012.1", "AML1012.4", "AML1016.1", "AML1016.2", "AML1019.1", "AML1019.5", "AML1022.1", "AML1022.3", "AML1026.1", "AML1026.4")]
scRNA <- merge(HSCT,y=c(C4,C43,C5,C82))
scRNA[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(scRNA, pattern = "^MT-")
scRNA[["percent.rb"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(scRNA, pattern = "^RP[SL]")

```

```{r}
#质控
plot.featrures = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt","percent.rb")
group = "orig.ident"
# 质控前小提琴图
theme.set2 = theme(axis.title.x=element_blank())
plots = list()
for(i in seq_along(plot.featrures)){
  plots[[i]] = VlnPlot(scRNA, group.by=group, pt.size = 0,
                       features = plot.featrures[i], raster = FALSE) + theme.set2 + NoLegend()}
wrap_plots(plots = plots, nrow=4)

scRNA3 <- subset(scRNA, subset = nCount_RNA < 20000 & nFeature_RNA > 200 & 
                  nFeature_RNA < 5000 & percent.mt < 8)
plots = list()
for(i in seq_along(plot.featrures)){
  plots[[i]] = VlnPlot(scRNA3, group.by=group, pt.size = 0,
                       features = plot.featrures[i], raster = FALSE) + theme.set2 + NoLegend()}
wrap_plots(plots = plots, nrow=4)  
scRNA <- scRNA3
```

#降维聚类
```{r}
scRNA <- NormalizeData(scRNA) %>% FindVariableFeatures(nfeatures = 2000) %>% ScaleData()
scRNA <- RunPCA(scRNA, verbose = F)
#去批次
scRNA <- RunHarmony(scRNA,group.by.vars = "orig.ident")
#维度
ElbowPlot(scRNA, ndims = 50)
pct <- scRNA[["pca"]]@stdev / sum(scRNA[["pca"]]@stdev) * 100
cumu <- cumsum(pct)
co1 <- which(cumu > 90 & pct < 5)[1]
co1
co2 <- sort(which((pct[1:length(pct) - 1] - pct[2:length(pct)]) > 0.1), decreasing = T)[1] + 1
co2
pcs <- min(co1, co2)
pcs
plot_df <- data.frame(pct = pct,
                      cumu = cumu,
                      rank = 1:length(pct))
ggplot(plot_df, aes(cumu, pct, label = rank, color = rank > pcs)) +
  geom_text() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 90, color = "grey") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = min(pct[pct > 5]), color = "grey") +
  theme_bw()
rm(pct,cumu,co1,co2,pcs,plot_df)
```

#恶性细胞专题
```{r}
Mal <- scRNA[,scRNA$Celltype %in% c("HSC/MPP",'GMP','MEP','CD14 Mono','CD16 Mono','cDC','pDC')]
Mal$Celltype <- factor(Mal$Celltype, levels = c("HSC/MPP","GMP","MEP","Mono","DC"))

Mal$type <- ifelse(Mal$prediction == "malignant", paste0(Mal$Celltype, "-like"), Mal$Celltype)
Mal$type <- gsub("1", "HSC/MPP", Mal$type)
Mal$type <- gsub("2", "GMP", Mal$type)
Mal$type <- gsub("3", "MEP", Mal$type)
Mal$type <- gsub("4", "Mono", Mal$type)
Mal$type <- gsub("5", "DC", Mal$type)

Mal$type <- factor(Mal$type, levels = c("HSC/MPP","HSC/MPP-like","GMP","GMP-like","MEP","MEP-like","Mono","Mono-like","DC","DC-like"))

Idents(Mal) <- 'prediction'
Mal.markers <- FindAllMarkers(Mal, only.pos = FALSE, min.pct = 0.25, logfc.threshold = 0.25)
write.csv(Mal.markers,file = "Mal.allmarkers.csv")
#细胞周期
s.genes <- cc.genes.updated.2019$s.genes
g2m.genes <- cc.genes.updated.2019$g2m.genes
Mal <- CellCycleScoring(Mal, s.features = s.genes, g2m.features = g2m.genes)
DimPlot(Mal, group.by = "Phase", label = TRUE)
```

##CRvsNR 4组
```{r}
CN <- scRNA[,scRNA$condition %in% c('CR','NR')]
CN$ph <- ""
CN$ph <- ifelse(CN$condition == "CR", paste("CR-", CN$prediction, sep = ""), CN$ph)
CN$ph <- ifelse(CN$condition == "NR", paste("NR-", CN$prediction, sep = ""), CN$ph)
#柱形图
ba <- as.data.frame(as.matrix(table(CN$Celltype,CN$ph)))
ba$Var1 <- factor(ba$Var1, levels = c("HSC/MPP","GMP","MEP","Early Ery","Mid Ery","Later Ery","CD14 Mono","CD16 Mono","cDC","pDC","CD4 T","CD8 T", "NK", "B"), ordered = TRUE)
ba$Var2 <- factor(ba$Var2, levels = c("CR-normal","CR-malignant","NR-normal","NR-malignant"))
color_palette <- c("CR-malignant"='#033E60',"CR-normal"='#A5D1EA',
                   "NR-malignant"='#7E1701',"NR-normal"='#ED8989')
ggplot(ba, aes(x = Var1, y = Freq, fill = Var2)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack") +#dodge展开的意思
  labs(x = "Cell type", y = "Number of cell") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = color_palette) + 
  theme_minimal()+
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 6400, by = 1000)) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),  # 去掉网格线
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),  # 设置坐标轴颜色
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),  # 旋转x轴标签
    axis.ticks.y = element_line(),  # 保留y轴刻度线
    legend.position = "top",  # 将图例放在顶部
    legend.title = element_blank()  # 隐藏图例标题
  )

```

```{r}
#双向富集
library(readxl)
df=read_excel("fuji.xlsx")

df <- df %>% arrange(class,desc(pvalue))
df$LogPvalue <- ifelse(df$class == "malignant", log10(df$pvalue),-log10(df$pvalue))
df$Description <- factor(df$Description,level=df$Description)
x_max = max(abs(df$LogPvalue))
color_list <- c('#d55640',"#68B6D4")
ggplot(df,aes(x =LogPvalue, y = Description, fill = class)) + 
  geom_col() + 
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-x_max,x_max)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = color_list) +
  geom_text(data = df[which(df$class == "normal"),],
            aes(x = -0.5, y = Description, label = Description,color = class),
            size = 4,
            hjust = 1) + 
  geom_text(data = df[which(df$class == "malignant"),],
            aes(x = 0.5, y = Description, label = Description,color = class),
            size = 4,
            hjust = 0)  + 
  scale_colour_manual(values = color_list) +
  labs(x="log10(P)", y=NULL, title="GO bological process") +
  annotate("text", x = 25, y = 15, label = "normal", size = 10, fontface = "bold", color="#F59B85") +
  annotate("text", x = -25, y =5, label = "malignant", size =10, fontface = "bold", color="#68B6D4") +

    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.line.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    legend.position = 'none'
  )
```

##良恶OR
```{r}
Mal <- Mal[,Mal$Celltype %in% c("HSC/MPP","GMP","MEP","EBM","Early Ery","Monocyte","cDC","pDC")]
table(Mal$prediction,Mal$Celltype)
# 提供数据CRvsNR
cr_counts <-  c(1245, 2487, 1395, 883, 1950, 13271, 1006, 528)
ctrl_counts <- c(11376, 3672, 1393, 989, 441, 5829, 422, 211)
cell_types <- c("HSC/MPP","GMP","MEP","EBM","Early Ery","Monocyte","cDC","pDC")
# 创建一个函数来计算OR值、log2OR值和Fisher's精确检验的p值
calculate_OR_and_pvalue <- function(cr_count, ctrl_count) {
  # 计算OR值
  odds_ratio <- (cr_count[1] / cr_count[2]) / (ctrl_count[1] / ctrl_count[2])
  # 计算Fisher's精确检验的p值
  fisher_test <- fisher.test(matrix(c(cr_count, ctrl_count), nrow = 2))
  p_value <- fisher_test$p.value
  # 计算log2OR值
  log2_odds_ratio <- log2(odds_ratio)
  # 返回OR值、log2OR值和Fisher's精确检验的p值
  return(list(OR = odds_ratio, log2_OR = log2_odds_ratio, p_value = p_value))
}

# 创建一个空列表来存储OR值、log2OR值和Fisher's精确检验的p值
result_list <- list()

# 循环遍历每种细胞类型，并计算OR值、log2OR值和Fisher's精确检验的p值
for (i in seq_along(cell_types)) {
  cr_count <- c(cr_counts[i], sum(cr_counts))
  ctrl_count <- c(ctrl_counts[i], sum(ctrl_counts))
  result_list[[i]] <- calculate_OR_and_pvalue(cr_count, ctrl_count)
}

# 将结果组合成数据框
result_df <- data.frame(Cell_Type = cell_types, OR_Value = sapply(result_list, function(x) x$OR), 
                        log2_OR_Value = sapply(result_list, function(x) x$log2_OR),
                        p_value = sapply(result_list, function(x) x$p_value))

# 输出结果
print(result_df)
###CRvsNR柱形图
result_df$color <- ifelse(result_df$log2_OR_Value > 0, '#619CD9', '#E38D8C')
result_df$significance <- ifelse(result_df$p_value < 0.001, "***", ifelse(result_df$p_value < 0.01, "**", ifelse(result_df$p_value < 0.05, "*", "n.s")))

result_df$Cell_Type <- factor(result_df$Cell_Type, levels = c("HSC/MPP","GMP","MEP","EBM","Early Ery","Monocyte","cDC","pDC"), ordered = TRUE)
# Plot
ggplot(result_df, aes(x = Cell_Type, y = log2_OR_Value, fill = color)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_text(aes(label = significance, 
                y = ifelse(log2_OR_Value >= 0, log2_OR_Value-0.05, log2_OR_Value)), 
            vjust = ifelse(result_df$log2_OR_Value >= 0, -0.5, 1.5), size = 4) +  # 调整标签位置
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 10),  # 调整两个坐标轴的文本大小
        axis.ticks = element_line(size = 0.5),  # 调整坐标轴刻度的粗细
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),  # 移除主要网格线
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),  # 移除次要网格线
        axis.line = element_line(color = "black", size = 0.5),  # 线条细化
        panel.border = element_blank(),  # 移除面板边框
        panel.background = element_blank()) +  # 移除面板背景
  labs(x = "", y = "Enrichment
(log2OR)") +  # 更改坐标轴和标题的标签为中文
  scale_fill_identity() 
```

```{r}
  # 计算log2OR值
  log2_odds_ratio <- log2(odds_ratio)
  # 返回OR值、log2OR值和Fisher's精确检验的p值
  return(list(OR = odds_ratio, log2_OR = log2_odds_ratio, p_value = p_value))
}

# 创建一个空列表来存储OR值、log2OR值和Fisher's精确检验的p值
```

##时序密度图
```{r}
#CRvsNR 时序密度图
data<- data.frame(Pseudotime = cds$Pseudotime, condition = cds$condition)
ggplot(data, aes(x = Pseudotime, fill = condition)) +
    geom_density(alpha = 0.7) +
    labs(title = "Density Plot", x = "Pseudotime", y = "Density") +
    theme_minimal()+
    theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
          axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
          axis.line = element_line(color = "black", size = 0.5),
          axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"))+
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("#FF9933", "#CC3333"))+
    guides(fill = guide_legend(title = ""))#不显示legend title
#柱状图
ggplot(data, aes(x = condition, y = Pseudotime, fill = condition)) +
    geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.8) +
    theme_minimal() +
    coord_flip() +
    theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank()) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("#FF9933", "#CC3333"))

# 执行 t 检验
group1 <- data[data$condition == "NR", "Pseudotime"]
group2 <- data[data$condition == "CR", "Pseudotime"]
t.test(group1, group2)
#'#033E60', '#7E1701'
#分化CytoTRACE------------------------
library(ncdf4)
library(HiClimR)
library(Rfast)
suppressMessages(library(CytoTRACE2))
# 表达矩阵 count
Mye1 <- Mye1[, Mye1@meta.data$Celltype != 'Early Ery']
Exp = GetAssayData(object = Mye1, assay = "RNA")
Exp[1:3,1:3]
dim(Exp)
# 表型文件
Meta = data.frame(phenotype1=rownames(Mye1@meta.data),phenotype2 = Mye1@meta.data$Celltype1,
                  Celltype = Mye1@meta.data$Celltype,condition = Mye1@meta.data$condition,
                  prediction = Mye1@meta.data$prediction)
rownames(Meta) <- Meta$phenotype1
Meta$phenotype1 <- NULL
cytotrace2_result <- cytotrace2(Exp,
                                species = "human",  # 默认是 鼠
                                # slot_type = "counts",  # 默认 counts 或 data
                                is_seurat = FALSE, # 输入是否是 Seurat 对象
                                full_model = FALSE, # 使用17个模型的完整集合,默认5个模型的简化集合
                                ncores = 10)
cytotrace2_result[1:3,1:5]
data <- cbind(cytotrace2_result, Meta)
#绘制柱状图
data$phenotype2 <- factor(data$phenotype2, levels = c("HSC/MPP","GMP","MEP","cDC","pDC","CD14 Mono","CD16 Mono",
                                                  "HSC/MPP-like", "GMP-like","MEP-like","cDC-like","pDC-like","CD14 Mono-like","CD16 Mono-like"
                                                  ))
data$Celltype <- factor(data$Celltype, levels = c("HSC/MPP","GMP","MEP","cDC","pDC","CD14 Mono","CD16 Mono"))

ggplot(data, aes(x = prediction, y = CytoTRACE2_Score, color = prediction)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, median.color = "black", median.size = 1.25, size = 1.1) +
  labs(x = "Celltype",
       y = "CytoTRACE") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        axis.ticks = element_line())
```

#DC细胞重分聚类
```{r}
MD <- scRNA[,scRNA@meta.data$Celltype %in% c("MD")]
MD <- NormalizeData(MD) %>% FindVariableFeatures(nfeatures = 2000) %>% ScaleData()
MD <- RunPCA(MD, verbose = F)
#去批次
MD <- RunHarmony(MD,group.by.vars = "orig.ident")
#维度
ElbowPlot(MD, ndims = 50)
pct <- MD[["pca"]]@stdev / sum(MD[["pca"]]@stdev) * 100
cumu <- cumsum(pct)
co1 <- which(cumu > 90 & pct < 5)[1]
co1
co2 <- sort(which((pct[1:length(pct) - 1] - pct[2:length(pct)]) > 0.1), decreasing = T)[1] + 1
co2
pcs <- min(co1, co2)
pcs
plot_df <- data.frame(pct = pct,
                      cumu = cumu,
                      rank = 1:length(pct))
ggplot(plot_df, aes(cumu, pct, label = rank, color = rank > pcs)) +
  geom_text() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 90, color = "grey") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = min(pct[pct > 5]), color = "grey") +
  theme_bw()
rm(pct,cumu,co1,co2,pcs,plot_df)

MD <- MD %>% RunUMAP(dims=1:11,reduction = "harmony")
DimPlot(MD, split.by = 'orig.ident',label = T,ncol = 8)
MD <- FindNeighbors(MD, dims=1:11,reduction = "harmony")
saveRDS(MD,'MD.rds')
#clustree
MD1 <- FindClusters(MD, resolution = c(seq(.1,1,.1)))
clustree(MD1@meta.data, prefix = "RNA_snn_res.")
MD <- FindClusters(MD,resolution = 0.2)
DimPlot(MD, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE)
MD.markers <- FindAllMarkers(MD, only.pos = TRUE, min.pct = 0.25, logfc.thresh = 0.25)
MD.top30 <- data.frame(MD.markers %>% group_by(cluster) %>% slice_max(n = 30, order_by = avg_log2FC))
write.csv(MD.top30,file = "MD.top30.csv")
write.csv(MD.markers,file = "MD.allmarkers.csv")
#MD细胞命名
cluster_names <- c("0" = "cDC","1" = "cDC","2" = "pDC", "3" = "Pro DC","4" = "Pro DC","5" = "cDC")
MD$Celltype <- cluster_names[MD$seurat_clusters]
MD$Celltype <- 'DC'
#分类
common_columns <- which(rownames(scRNA@meta.data) %in% rownames(MD@meta.data))
length(common_columns)
scRNA@meta.data$Celltype[common_columns] <- MD$Celltype
```

# HSC静止活动数据
```{r}
QAdata <- read.csv("/data5/tiany/HSCTAML/HSCTRR/ENO1Bulk/Activated_VS_QuiescentLTHSC.csv",header = T)

QAdataupdown<-subset(QAdata,abs(logFC)>2 &abs(FDR)<0.01&genename!="None")

QAdataup<-subset(QAdata,logFC>2 &abs(FDR)<0.05 &genename!="None")

QAdatadown<-subset(QAdata,logFC<as.numeric(-2) &abs(FDR)<0.05&genename!="None")
QAdataupdown$type<-ifelse(QAdataupdown$logFC<0,"AvsQ_Down","AvsQ_UP")

library(GSVA)
genesets2_AQ<-split(QAdataupdown$genename, QAdataupdown$type)
#构建矩阵，单细胞
Idents(HSC) <- 'Celltype'
expr <- AverageExpression(HSC, assays = "RNA", slot = "data")[[1]]
expr <- expr[rowSums(expr)>0,]  #过滤细胞表达量全为零的基因
expr <- as.matrix(expr)
head(expr)
#bulk 构建矩阵用FPKM
colnames(DEG)
expr <- DEG[,c("M13_NC-RNA_1_fpkm","M13_NC-RNA_2_fpkm",  
               "M13_NC-RNA_3_fpkm","M13_sh2-RNA_1_fpkm" ,
               "M13_sh2-RNA_2_fpkm","M13_sh2-RNA_3_fpkm")]
colnames(expr) <- c('CON1','CON2','CON3','ENO1_KO1','ENO1_KO2','ENO1_KO3')
expr <- as.matrix(expr)

gsva.res_AQ<- gsva(expr, genesets2_AQ, method="ssgsea") 

gsva.res_AQt<-t(gsva.res_AQ) %>% as.data.frame()
rownames_to_column(gsva.res_AQt)->gsva.res_AQt
#计算差异
Con <- gsva.res_AQt[1:3, c("AvsQ_Down", "AvsQ_UP")]
ENO1 <- gsva.res_AQt[4:6, c("AvsQ_Down", "AvsQ_UP")]
# 执行t检验
t_test_result <- t.test(Con$AvsQ_Down, ENO1$AvsQ_Down)

ggplot(gsva.res_AQt)+geom_point(aes(x=AvsQ_UP,y=AvsQ_Down,color=rowname),size=3)+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#D35400","#E67E22","#E59866","#82E0AA","#2ECC71","#28B463"))+
  labs(x = "LT-HSC activate score", y = "LT-HSC quite score") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_blank(),  # 移除背景颜色
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),  # 移除主要网格线
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),  # 移除次要网格线
    axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),# 添加x和y轴
    axis.ticks = element_line(colour = "black") # 添加刻度线
  )+guides(color = guide_legend(title = NULL))+  # 移除图例标题
  geom_text(label = paste("p =", round(t_test_result, 4)), hjust = 1, vjust = 0, size = 4)

```

#Tcell
```{r}
Tcell <- scRNA[,scRNA@meta.data$Celltype %in% c("CD4 T","CD8 T")]
Tcell <- Tcell[!grepl("^HBB|^HBA|^HBD|^HBC|^MT-|^RPS|^RPL|^MTRNR", rownames(Tcell)), ]
Tcell <- NormalizeData(Tcell) %>% FindVariableFeatures(nfeatures = 2000) %>% ScaleData()
Tcell <- RunPCA(Tcell, verbose = F)
#去批次
Tcell <- RunHarmony(Tcell,group.by.vars = "orig.ident")
#维度
ElbowPlot(Tcell, ndims = 50)
pct <- Tcell[["pca"]]@stdev / sum(Tcell[["pca"]]@stdev) * 100
cumu <- cumsum(pct)
co1 <- which(cumu > 90 & pct < 5)[1]
co1
co2 <- sort(which((pct[1:length(pct) - 1] - pct[2:length(pct)]) > 0.1), decreasing = T)[1] + 1
co2
pcs <- min(co1, co2)
pcs
plot_df <- data.frame(pct = pct,
                      cumu = cumu,
                      rank = 1:length(pct))
ggplot(plot_df, aes(cumu, pct, label = rank, color = rank > pcs)) +
  geom_text() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 90, color = "grey") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = min(pct[pct > 5]), color = "grey") +
  theme_bw()
rm(pct,cumu,co1,co2,pcs,plot_df)

Tcell3 <- Tcell %>% RunUMAP(dims=1:15,reduction = "harmony")
DimPlot(Tcell, split.by = 'orig.ident',label = T,ncol = 8)
Tcell3 <- FindNeighbors(Tcell3, dims=1:15,reduction = "harmony")
saveRDS(Tcell,'Tcell.rds')
#clustree
Tcell1 <- FindClusters(Tcell, resolution = c(seq(.1,1,.1)))
clustree(Tcell1@meta.data, prefix = "RNA_snn_res.")
Tcell <- FindClusters(Tcell,resolution = 1.0)
DimPlot(Tcell, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE)
#查看比例
as.matrix(prop.table(table(Tcell$seurat_clusters, Tcell$Treatment), margin = 2)*100) 
Tcell$condition <- factor(Tcell$condition, levels = c("HC", "CR", "NR"))
Tcell$Treatment <- factor(Tcell$Treatment, levels = c("Control", "Before", "After"))
Idents(Tcell) <- 'tc'
Tcell.markers <- FindAllMarkers(Tcell, only.pos = TRUE, min.pct = 0.25, logfc.threshB = 0.25)
Tcell.top30 <- data.frame(Tcell.markers %>% group_by(cluster) %>% slice_max(n = 30, order_by = avg_log2FC))
write.csv(Tcell.top30,file = "Tcelltc.30.csv")
write.csv(Tcell.markers,file = "Tcelltc.allmarkers.csv")
```

```{r}
#蝴蝶GO图
library(readxl)
library(ggplot2)
library(cowplot)
C6 <- read_excel('./C6G.xlsx')
C7 <- read_excel('./C7G.xlsx')

#按 p 值排序，同时当两数据不等长时补充空白数据（尽可能使蝴蝶图对称）
C6 <- C6[order(C6$Count, decreasing = F), ]
C6$Description <- factor(C6$Description, levels = C6$Description)
id_C6 <- levels(C6$Description)
C7 <- C7[order(C7$Count, decreasing = F), ]
C7$Description <- factor(C7$Description, levels = C7$Description)
id_C7 <- levels(C7$Description)

n <- length(C6$Description) - length(C7$Description)
if (n > 0) {
  C7$Description <- as.character(C7$Description)
  for (i in paste('nn', as.character(seq(1, n, 1)), sep = '')) C7 <- rbind(list(i, NA, NA), C7)
  C7$Description <- factor(C7$Description, levels = C7$Description)
  id_C7 <- c(rep('', n), id_C7)
} else if (n < 0) {
  C6$Description <- as.character(C6$Description)
  for (i in paste('nn', as.character(seq(1, abs(n), 1)), sep = '')) C6 <- rbind(list(i, NA, NA), C6)
  C6$Description <- factor(C6$Description, levels = C6$Description)
  id_C6 <- c(rep('', abs(n)), id_C6)
}
#C6G
p_C6 <- ggplot(C6, aes(Description, -Count,fill=-log(pvalue, 10))) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = -log(pvalue, 10)), width = 0.6) +  # 绘制柱状图，填充颜色为红色，边框颜色为黑色，柱子宽度为0.6
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), panel.background = element_rect(fill = 'transparent')) +  # 设置主题，去除网格和背景
  theme(axis.line.x = element_line(colour = 'black'), axis.line.y = element_line(colour = 'transparent'), axis.ticks.y = element_line(colour = 'transparent')) +  # 设置坐标轴样式
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = 'plain')) + 
  coord_flip() + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +  
  labs(x = '', y = '', title = 'CD8-C6-LAG3') +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#6CA3EA", high = "#0554B9") +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = id_C6)+
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), breaks = c(-20, -15, -10, -5, 0),
                     labels = as.character(abs(c(-20, -15, -10, -5, 0))))+
  theme(legend.position = "left")
#C7G

  geom_col(aes(fill = -log(pvalue, 10)), width = 0.6) +

  theme(axis.line.x = element_line(colour = 'black'), axis.line.y = element_line(colour = 'transparent'), axis.ticks.y = element_line(colour = 'transparent')) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = 'plain')) +
```

```{r}
combined <- combineTCR(contig_list, samples = c('AML1007.1.GEX','AML1019.1.GEX','AML1010.1.GEX','AML1012.1.GEX','AML1016.1.GEX','AML1022.1.GEX','AML1026.1.GEX','AML1008.1.GEX'),cells ="T-AB")

                            cloneCall="gene",

                            proportion = FALSE, 
                            cloneTypes=c(Single=1, Small=5, Medium=20, Large=100, Hyperexpanded=500))

Tcell2 <- Tcell[,Tcell@meta.data$condition %in% c('CR','NR')]
Tcell2$TCR <- ifelse(Tcell2$cloneType %in% c("Hyperexpanded (100 < X <= 500)", "Large (20 < X <= 100)", "Medium (5 < X <= 20)", "Small (1 < X <= 5)","Single (0 < X <= 1)"),"TCR+", "TCR-")

DimPlot(Tcell2, group.by = "cloneType",label = F,cols = c( "#F0F921FF","#FA9E3BFF","#D8576BFF", "#7301A8FF","#0D0887FF"),split.by = 'condition',ncol = 1)

clonalOverlap(combined2, cloneCall="aa", method="overlap")+theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1))

                  cloneCall="aa", graph = "alluvial") +  scale_fill_npg()

clonalOverlap(NRT2, cloneCall="aa", method="overlap")+theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1),plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))+ggtitle("NR")

CRT2 <- expression2List(CRT, split.by = "tc")
clonalOverlap(CRT2, cloneCall="aa", method="overlap")+theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1),plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))+ggtitle("CR")
```

```{r}
#随机
remove_random_cells <- function(seurat_obj, celltype, condition, num_remove) {
    # 找到符合条件的细胞
    cells_to_remove <- WhichCells(seurat_obj, cells = which(seurat_obj$Celltype == celltype & seurat_obj$condition1 == condition))
    
    # 检查是否有足够的细胞可供删除
    if (length(cells_to_remove) < num_remove) {
        stop("Not enough cells to remove")
    }
    
    # 随机选择需要删除的细胞
    cells_to_remove_sample <- sample(cells_to_remove, num_remove)
    
    # 删除这些细胞
    seurat_obj <- subset(seurat_obj, cells = setdiff(Cells(seurat_obj), cells_to_remove_sample))
    
    return(seurat_obj)
}

# 假设 HSC2 是你的 Seurat 对象，并删除 After treatment 中 HSC/MPP4 群的 700 个细胞
HSC2 <- remove_random_cells(HSC2, celltype = "HSC/MPP4", condition = "After treatment", num_remove = 700)
```
